text: A bold gym interval timer signal: three very clear punchy electronic beeps, BEEP BEEP BEEEP, the last held slightly longer. Bright focused midrange with a rounded body, immediate attack, obvious rhythmic separation. Designed to be unmistakable during hard exercise with music playing. Assertive professional sports timer, not a phone notification. No siren, no melody, no voice, no music, no ambience or echo.
